title: Angel
text: “I’m home!”
“‘Kwaa!’”
It was just before sunset. As I was waiting at the riverbank where we’d agreed to meet, my Father and the others came back. It looks like both Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan have become Filolial Queens.
“Their appearances changed partway through—is everything okay?”
“Everything’s fine. In fact, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say this is their true form.”
“Huh… It’s kind of like evolving in a simulation game, isn’t it?”
As we were chatting like this, my father got off Sakura-chan. As soon as he stepped down, he started rubbing his crotch as if it hurt.
“Man… It really rubs your crotch raw if you’re not used to riding them.”
“Should I cast a healing spell on you?”
“Ah, I’m fine. The Siltvelt messenger cast one on me along the way.”
“Is that so?”
“Oink…”
With a thud, the Siltvelt pig tumbled off Yuki-chan. At the same time, Éclair covered her mouth with her hand, her face turning pale as she leaned against Yuki-chan.
“Gah, I’ve had enough…”
She fell with a thud and looks like she’s on the verge of death.
“You can earn EXP at an incredible rate just by knocking monsters away… but this is unbearable…”
“Well, the ride isn’t exactly comfortable, is it…?”
“Lord Iwatani is abnormal. To say he’s fine after riding this…”
“Even if you say that…”

My Father is scratching his head, mumbling to himself. It’s only natural. He stands at the pinnacle of all Filolials and is the one who gave birth to Filo-tan. He doesn’t have the kind of weak spirit that would be shaken by a little shaking like this.
“So, how did today’s battle go?”
“I think we leveled up nicely. I hit Lv. 28. That’s amazing. I heard Eclair and the others leveled up a bit, too.”
“That’s wonderful. If possible, I’d like to help Father level up even more.”
“I know, but… shouldn’t we strengthen his shield or something?”
“You’re right.”
Come to think of it, I should take Father to the town’s weapon shop. We can’t increase his equipment options unless we let him use Weapon Copy.
“Hey, Motoyasu. Is it okay to use the shields we have available right now to enhance weapons?”
“No problem at all. If there are any materials you need, I’ll get them for you. If Father’s Defense Power goes up, we won’t have to be quite so wary of assassins.”
“Thanks. Then I’ll pick out some shields from what’s available now that seem to have high stats.”

There’s no guarantee the town’s weapon shop will have good shields in stock. Since you probably don’t have enough yet for Forging or Awakening, you’re likely trying out the enhancement methods I and Itsuki use. Even just that should be enough to block attacks from ordinary adventurers and soldiers.
“With this, my Father has gotten a bit stronger, hasn’t he?”
“He’s still nowhere near as strong as you, Motoyasu-kun. He can’t even use a single spell… and he still needs to unlock his Skills.”
“Still, it’s a big step forward.”
“Yeah. I kind of get the illusion that I’ve suddenly gotten stronger.”

I’d like to get Father up to Level 40 by tomorrow. After improving Yuki-chan and the others’ stats, we decided to head to the town inn. We put Éclair and the pig to sleep in the carriage, and we went into town.
“Phew… I hope we can get some rest tonight.”
My Father grumbled as he sat on the bed in our inn room. It’s true—being chased by assassins these past few days has been rough.

At first glance, this town seems quieter than the one we stayed in last time. It doesn’t look like anyone’s going to storm the inn out of the blue. Well, it seems the bodyguards Siltvelt hired are standing guard right in front of the inn. I wonder if they’ll be traveling with us starting tomorrow?

Éclair and the others are already asleep in the next room. Apparently, they’re so hungover they need medical attention. A messenger has gone to buy some medicine. For now, at least, Yuki-chan and the others are more than enough to guard my Father.
“Well then, I’m heading to the inn’s stable.”
“Huh? Motoyasu-kun, aren’t you going to sleep in your room?”
“I still have work to do tonight.”
“What’s there to do?”
“In that case, my Father should be present as well.”
I lead my Father out to the inn’s stable. Yuki-chan and the others were waiting there, looking a bit restless.
“Sorry to keep you waiting.”
As soon as they saw me, Yuki-chan and the others cheerfully responded. As a reward for their hard work today, I sliced up some Smoked Meat that my Father had made and fed it to them.
“So? What’s going on?”
“It’s about time…”
Yuki-chan and the others were happily chirping “Kue, kue.” I whispered to them.
“Filolial-sama and the others, I believe it’s about time you took on your angelic forms. Please… show us those forms.”
At my words, Yuki-chan and the others exchanged glances, stretched their backs, and… began to transform.
“Eh…”
Accompanied by a soft glow, Yuki-chan and the others’ forms gradually changed into those of angels. Seeing them like this, my Father was left speechless.

Outwardly, they all have the same hair color as when they were in their Filolial-sama forms… and wings sprouting from their backs. Their builds are basically the same. Hmm? Is Yuki-chan perhaps a little taller? Her sharp expression exudes a sense of leadership.
Kou seems like a boy with a strong sense of curiosity. And Sakura-chan… well, what would you call her? Maybe the “gentle and laid-back” type? She looks a little sleepy.
“Motoyasu-sama—”
“Motoyasu—”
“Yes, sir!”
Except for Kou, they all called out my name. Ah… they’re all so cute. My father is gaping in astonishment.
“I’d… heard about it, but seeing it with my own eyes is quite a shock. It makes me want to go talk to Ms. Eclair.”
“She’s resting in her room right now.”
“Yeah. I know, but…”
“Naofumi!”
Sakura-chan runs over to my father.
“Are you… Sakura-chan?”
“Yep! It’s Sakura!”
Sakura, her cherry-blossom-colored hair flowing, throws herself into my Father’s arms—completely naked.
“Whoa!”
My Father’s eyes widen in shock as he catches Sakura-chan and ruffles her hair. Looking up at him, Sakura-chan flashes a smile.
“Ehehe—”
“This is the first time we’ve actually talked like this, isn’t it?”
“Yeah. Um, I’ve wanted to talk to you ever since we met. Thanks for patting my head!”
“Ah, yeah…”
As if unsure where to look, Father gazed off into the distance.
“Motoyasu-kun. Aren’t you going to dress these kids?”
“I’ve procured the necessary equipment for that. Quick! Yuki-chan and the others, there are tools for making clothes, so please start using them.”
“Why?”
She asks Filolial-sama first.
“It’s because wearing clothes will make all of you even more charming.”
“Motoyasu-sama, do you think Yuki should wear clothes?”
“Clothes, huh? I’d like to try dressing up a bit, Yuki.”
“Naofumi, do you want Sakura to wear clothes?”

Sakura is quite the little sweetheart. The way she gets along so well with her Father reminds me of Filo-tan. However, her hair and eye colors are different from Filo-tan’s. She’s a bit laid-back, and her steps are slow. Her hair is styled into a shape resembling a floral wreath. While she’s certainly charming, her hair texture also feels different from Filo-tan’s. Sakura-chan is just a bit of a missed opportunity in every way.
“Um, yeah. It’d be helpful if you wore some clothes.”
Sakura-chan nodded at Father’s words.
“Okay then, Sakura, I’ll put on some clothes—”
“In that case, I, Yuki, will go first.”
“Ah, I want to go first—”
“No, you can’t.”
“Boo…”
Sakura-chan is holding back. It seems Yuki-chan is acting as the leader of the three of them.
“Hm?”
Kou is standing there. Come to think of it, Kou hasn’t called me by my name yet. As I approached and gave him a gentle smile, Kou said:
“Kitamura.”
“Yes, sir.”
“Wait… why is Kou the only one calling Motoyasu-kun by his last name?”
After this little episode, Kou started spinning the equipment’s handle all by himself.
“Ahahaha—this is so fun!”
“Hey! Kou, you’re not supposed to spin it on your own.”
Saying that, Yuki scolded Kou. It’s such a heartwarming sight.
“With this… it looks like it’ll be okay for us to sleep in the room, right?”
“That’s right.”
After making sure Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan had finished spinning the thread, she dressed all three of them in their makeshift pajamas.
“Is that all right? You must watch over your Father properly in the room and sleep like good children, you know.”
“We know.”
Yuki-chan is so smart. She reminds me of Midori.
“Yeah. Sakura wants to sleep with Naofumi, too!”
“All right, all right. If you’re a good girl, I’ll let you sleep with me.”
“Yay!”

Sakura looks delighted, and my Father is gently stroking her hair. I remember very well how skilled he is with children. My Filolial-sama also cherished my Father dearly. Kou is spinning thread at high speed, using a machine that transforms Magical Power into threads with a whirring sound. Yuki-chan follows suit.
“O-okay, Sakura’s next.”
“O-okay!”
Sakura-chan grabs the machine’s handle and starts turning it. However, perhaps because she’s doing things at her own pace, she’s moving rather slowly.
“Sakura, can’t you turn it a little faster?”
“Huh?”
Sakura-chan looks over at my Father.
“Naofumi, do you want me to go faster?”
“It doesn’t seem like it’s taking that long, so don’t worry about it.”
“Oh, okay. Then I’ll just spin it slowly.”
Saying that, Sakura began spinning the thread.
“Haa… Kou’s getting sleepy…”
“Yuki’s sleepy, too.”
“Well then, we’ll head to the bedroom first.”

While Sakura-chan spins her thread, Yuki-chan and the others yawn and keep saying they’re sleepy over and over. Since Father signaled that it’s okay for us to go ahead, I, Motoyasu, will lead Yuki-chan and the others.
“Alright, I’ll set the thread aside once Sakura-chan is done, so Motoyasu-kun, you go ahead and sleep with everyone else.”
“Understood. Sakura-chan, if anything happens, you must protect my Father.”
“Got it!”

Sakura-chan seemed to be enjoying spinning the thread; she played around by spinning it slowly at times and whirring it around at high speed at others. My Father watched over her warmly. Feeling all warm and fuzzy inside at the sight, I led everyone back to the room and went to sleep.
